subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: XY123 Departure: Date, Time Arrival: Date, Time Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact our customer service team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Regards, The Airline Team
